gate_type: REVIEW/ADMISSION gate — SH-WTP Synthetic Runtime Admission Review (G12C)
objective: Review readiness and decide, candidate by candidate, which of UNIT-SHW-L1-T106 / UNIT-SHW-L1-T108 / UNIT-SHW-WASH-T110 may receive synthetic/reference black-box behavior in a future G13. Freeze one of SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ALLOWED / STRUCTURAL_ONLY / BLOCKED_PENDING_EVIDENCE per candidate, grounded in the accepted G10 boundary contracts, fidelity ceilings, and G12B inert PIM reference connectivity. No runtime implementation, no PIM change, no G4 projection, no site authorization. Keep vf_runtime_authorization and site_authorized_execution NOT_AUTHORIZED; only future candidate-by-candidate synthetic/reference execution may be authorized; G13 must choose the smallest meaningful executable slice. Planning/config/test/report artifacts only.
explicit_non_objectives: No G4 projection / BoundaryPort / PortDirection / PortCategory / CompositionBinding / coordinator / run-control / state propagation
No site authorization / SiteVerified / SourceMapped / site-faithful control or physics
No silent semantic reclassification of raw G12B relations (FLOWS_TO/DISCHARGES_TO/CONNECTED_TO) into runtime direction/medium/merge/split/coordinator semantics
No new executable candidates beyond T106/T108/T110
required_deliverables: configs/vnext/shwtp/shwtp_synthetic_runtime_admission.json (candidate admission matrix + synthetic assumption policy + runtime projection readiness + G13 authorization plan)
forbidden_actions: Relabel synthetic assumptions as plant truth
stop_conditions: Admission requires choosing an unstated physical/control model
A missing plant parameter must be invented as truth
An ambiguous PIM relationship must be semantically resolved
vf_runtime_authorization or site authorization must change
A product decision is required on which fidelity/behavior family to use beyond the frozen progressive-refinement principle

acceptance_criteria.description: Only T106/T108/T110 reviewed; each candidate has an explicit deterministic admission classification
Fidelity ceiling not exceeded; no ParameterizedReady/CalibratedReady fabricated
PIM-supported facts / synthetic assumptions / unknown-blocking visibly separated
Synthetic assumption policy frozen (explicit/provenance-marked/scenario-driven/not plant truth)
No raw G12B relation silently runtime-classified
G13 plan selects the smallest meaningful executable slice; no default authorization of all three
Runtime projection readiness listed for ALLOWED candidates but not implemented
Complete canonical vNext baseline + G12B/G12A/G11/G10/G9/G7/G4/ASSY/continuous/UI/full suite green
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed
